desc: Prove or exhaustively validate that infeasibility is exactly caused by shared-geometrical-endpoint pairs or same-direction strict-crossing pairs, including equality-component/strict-cycle obstructions and mixed directions.
Replace the crossing search with an offline 2D Fenwick structure supporting worst-case O(log² N) point updates and rectangle existence checks.
Prove the sliding-window boundary computation and range-maximum query reduction.
Establish final worst-case time and memory bounds under all constraints.
Implement a candidate Python solution with fast I/O; it passes both public samples.
